Title: C# Properties (Get/Set)
Description: Properties combine fields and methods to protect data.

Challenges.Title: Private field
Challenges.Exercise: Create a class `Person` with a private string field `name`.

Challenges.Title: Public property
Challenges.Exercise: Add a public string property `Name` to `Person`.

Challenges.Title: Get accessor
Challenges.Exercise: Inside the `Name` property, add a get accessor returning `name`.

Challenges.Title: Set accessor
Challenges.Exercise: Add a set accessor assigning `value` to `name`.

Challenges.Title: Auto-Property
Challenges.Exercise: Create an auto-property `public string Age { get; set; }`.
